integrity: The 1968 foundational article and the complete 1971 and 1973 same-object analyses were inspected at equation and implication level. The 1971 source explicitly contains the global period-average identity, which is treated as prior rather than new. A modern complete global phase-portrait article was checked for invariant-measure, average, and moment formulations. The new conditional and covariance-speed statements were independently reconstructed and the polynomial identities were replayed from the packaged exact checker.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns compactly supported invariant probability measures supported in the positive quadrant.
The conditional identities constrain moments but do not determine the full invariant density or cycle period.
The global period-average identity \(\langle x\rangle=A\) is prior literature and is explicitly excluded from the originality claim.
An equivalent short generator formulation could remain in unindexed chemical-oscillation literature.
title: Exact stationary slice calibrations and variance-speed rigidity in the Brusselator
